none: PAS ESS-11A6C8: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine II
contea di ritrovamento: Essex (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ [GLO]R IAEXERC ITVS

A copper alloy nummus of Constantine II (AD317-340) dating to AD330-335. Reece Period 17. Obverse shows a diademed bust facing right. Obverse legend reads CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse depicts two soldiers holding two standards. Reverse legend reads [GLO]R IAEXERC ITVS. Mint not known. Die axis: 6 o'clock. Diameter: 15.43mm. Thickness: 1.66mm. Weight: 1.86g
